save-coffee: Cover: “Save 10,000 a day — coffee!!”, a vintage collage of cash, bank cards and a cup of coffee
Coffee lovers spend on average 10,000₮ a day, 300,000₮ a month and 3,650,000₮ a year at coffee shops
How can this expense be cut to 1,670₮ a day?
The quickest, easiest way: make your own coffee, with a pour-over coffee maker illustration
What you need: 500 g of ground beans for 45,000₮, 100 paper filters for 5,000₮ and a drip coffee set for 60,000₮
The maths: one cup costs 1,620₮, saving 8,330₮ a day, 249,900₮ a month and 2,980,450₮ a year
Financial discipline isn't giving up what you love; it starts with small habits
